question: Which footballer was honored with the Presidential Medal of Freedom by US President Joe Biden in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lionel Messi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Joe Biden honored 19 individuals with the Presidential Medal of Freedom, the United States' highest civilian honor.**
 
• **Lionel Messi, a globally renowned footballer, was named among the honorees but could not attend the White House ceremony.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Presidential Medal of Freedom is the highest civilian honor in the United States.**
 
• Among the recipients were Hillary Clinton, Bono, Michael J. Fox, and Magic Johnson.
 
• Lionel Messi was named for his contribution to sports and global influence but was unable to attend.
 
• **Posthumous awards were given to Robert F. Kennedy, Ashton Carter, Fannie Lou Hamer, and George Romney.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Presidential Medal of Freedom__

 __
 
• Established in 1963 by President John F. Kennedy.
 
• Awarded for exceptional contributions to the security or national interests of the US, world peace, culture, or other significant endeavors.
 
 
 
• Lionel Messi__
 
 
• Widely regarded as one of the greatest footballers of all time.
 
• Has won numerous accolades, including multiple Ballon d'Or awards and international titles with Argentina.
 
• Recognized globally for his contribution to sports and philanthropy.
